title.narrative: International missions carried out by The Danish National Police

description.narrative: The Danish National Police (DNP) supports several international, UN and EU civilian missions as well as short-term missions in developing countries. All missions are non-military and provides assistance for authorities in development countries. The support includes activities related to civilian peacebuilding, conflict prevention and resolution. The civilian missions’ objectives are further: Promoting law and order; strengthening the rule of law including through support to security sector reforms; providing education to local police within a wide array of police concepts and methods; enhancing police capacity in preventing and fighting crime; and promoting human rights-based law enforcement in post-conflict and developing countries.
